title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → AcademicOrg
architecture_notes: Workday Student models the academic hierarchy as Academic Units (school → college → division → department). Academic Units own courses, programs, and are distinct from the HCM supervisory organizations and FIN cost centers, though they often align. Equivalent to PS_ACAD_ORG_TBL.

source_objects.description: Academic organizational entity: college, school, division, department. Hierarchical. Equivalent to PS_ACAD_ORG_TBL.
Parent-child relationships. Equivalent to PS_TREE_NODE for ACAD_ORG.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. E.g., 'Department of Computer Science'.
Cross-reference to FIN cost center if the institution links academic and financial orgs.
